chars.NEIGHBOUR: NEIGHBOUR: a Moroccan woman in her late 40s, plump, sharp suspicious eyes, wearing a mustard-yellow djellaba with a bright green headscarf tied back, house slippers
chars.BOY: BOY: an 18-year-old Moroccan young man, short black hair, light stubble, wearing a grey hoodie and black joggers, white sneakers
chars.MOM: MOM: a Moroccan woman in her early 40s, elegant, shoulder-length dark wavy hair, wearing a dusty-rose long-sleeve blouse and wide cream trousers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Stairwell of a modest Casablanca apartment building, seen from a few steps below. NEIGHBOUR stands on the landing blocking BOY's way, hands on hips, leaning toward him, eyebrows raised in suspicion as if asking a nosy question; BOY freezes with one foot on the step, awkward forced smile. Head-to-waist framing, both faces clearly visible, comic tense mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same stairwell landing, closer. NEIGHBOUR slowly looks BOY up and down with narrowed eyes and a pursed mouth; BOY scratches the back of his neck, avoiding her gaze. Warm afternoon light from a small window. Comic awkward mood.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Stairwell landing next to a closed wooden apartment door with a brass number. NEIGHBOUR points with her thumb at the closed door while whispering to BOY with a knowing look; BOY listens wide-eyed. Gossip mood.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Stairwell landing. NEIGHBOUR wags her index finger in BOY's face, warning him with a stern half-smile; behind them, two other apartment doors are slightly open with curious eyes peeking through the gaps. BOY leans back nervously. Comic gossip mood.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: BOY walking up the stairs away from the landing, rolling his eyes and muttering to himself in annoyance, hands in his hoodie pocket. Stairwell with tiled walls and an iron railing. Light comic mood.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: View from inside a dim apartment doorway: NEIGHBOUR peeks through the narrow gap of her half-open door, one eye and a jealous frown visible, watching MOM across the landing; MOM, elegant and calm, unlocks her own door holding a shopping bag, unaware. Comic jealous mood.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: BOY in front of the building entrance mirror in the lobby, straightening his hoodie and posing confidently with his chin up, smiling at his own reflection as if he looked like a grown man. Bright lobby with mailboxes. Comic mood.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Building lobby: BOY walks past NEIGHBOUR toward the stairs with a cool shrug, ignoring her; NEIGHBOUR, sweeping the floor with a broom, stops and turns her head to glare at him. Comic mood.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Upper stairwell landing seen from behind NEIGHBOUR's half-open door: in the foreground NEIGHBOUR's face in profile pressed to the door gap, eyes wide and suspicious; in the background BOY knocks on the wooden door across the landing, looking over his shoulder nervously. Suspense, cliffhanger mood.
